title: Heavenly Fate Pact · Ye Qing's Promise
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing's figure vanished into the night, leaving only a profound words: 'Next time we meet, I'll take you to see someone.' Chen Ji clutched the letter in his hand, a sense of unease stirring in his heart—who could this person the Holy Sect Saint spoke of be?

text.content: The night wind cut like a blade through the silence of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Chen Ji stood at the cliff's edge, moonlight stretching his shadow long and desolate. The yellowed letter in his sleeve seemed to retain Master Mo's lingering warmth, its bold strokes radiating an ancient aura from another era—'This is me, ten years ago, writing this to you with my own hands.' Those words branded themselves into the depths of his heart. The seven-day pact was about to be fulfilled tonight. He narrowed his eyes slightly, fingertips unconsciously rubbing his cuff. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled subtly in his Mental Sea, the power of foresight stirring restlessly. He suppressed that impulse—every glimpse of the next three hours required consuming five points of Heavenly Fate. Unless absolutely necessary, he would never recklessly use it. In the distance, a ghostly purple light streaked across the night sky like a falling star, racing toward this direction. Chen Ji's lips curved slightly, that arc cold and composed: 'She's here.'

dialogue.content: 'Apologies for keeping you waiting.' The ghostly purple light converged, and Ye Qing's figure stepped out from the Void like a specter. Tonight she had changed into a plain white long dress, a color that should have been sacred, yet on her it added several points of otherworldly allure. Her black silk was casually pinned up with a purple jade hairpin, a few loose strands falling alongside her fair neck, making those phoenix eyes appear even more profound. She landed without sound, her tiptoes touching the rock, resembling a fairy descending from the moon, yet equally akin to an Asura crawling out of hell.

text.content: The night wind curled up her dress hem, carrying a faint, ethereal fragrance—not ordinary rouge and powder, but the distinctive 'Enchanting Heart Orchid' scent unique to the Holy Sect. Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged as he subtly shifted his body, tucking the letter deeper into his sleeve. 'Lady Ye is indeed punctual.' His voice was placid like still water. 'Seven days ago, you and I agreed to meet here tonight at the Hour of the Rat. Now the moon has reached its zenith—this is indeed the perfect hour.' Ye Qing approached slowly, each step carrying a certain rhythm, as if stepping on people's heartbeats. Her gaze lingered on Chen Ji's face for a moment, her expression seeming to smile yet not: 'Young Master Chen certainly possesses great courage. Knowing I am from the Holy Sect, you still dared to meet alone.'

dialogue.content: 'If Lady Ye wished to take my life, you could have acted seven days ago. Why wait until tonight?' Chen Ji met her gaze directly, unflinching. Those eyes appeared calm on the surface, yet hidden beneath was sharp brilliance—he had long seen through Ye Qing's true purpose for this visit, which was definitely not to take his life. 'Moreover,' he shifted his tone, adding a hint of playfulness, 'though Lady Ye is the Holy Sect Saintess, your days within the Holy Sect are probably not as flourishing as outsiders perceive, correct?' Ye Qing's footsteps paused slightly, a flicker of异样 crossing her eyes. That flicker vanished in an instant, yet it did not escape Chen Ji's sight. 'You have investigated me?' Her voice remained cold, yet carried an added dangerous undertone.

text.content: 'Nothing worth calling an investigation.' Chen Ji spoke calmly. 'Merely knowing a thing or two. The Holy Sect Saintess sounds extremely glorious, but in truth, she is merely a chess piece in the hands of the Holy Sect. The 'Heavenly Demon Sacrifice' every ten years—do you think those sacrificial offerings come from nowhere?' His voice was not loud, yet each word was like a blade, stabbing directly at the wound in Ye Qing's heart that she least wished to mention. The air seemed to freeze. Around Ye Qing, demonic energy began to stir restlessly, reminiscent of the oppressive feeling before a storm. Her fingers tightened slightly, knuckles whitening. In those phoenix eyes, killing intent condensed like substantial form. 'Chen Ji,' she articulated each word with icy coldness, her voice as frigid as spring water from the Nine Netherworlds, 'Do you understand what you are saying?' Chen Ji remained expressionless, as if not sensing that suffocating pressure at all: 'I understand. What I am saying is that Lady Ye needs an opportunity to change her fate.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's killing intent receded like an ebbing tide the instant Chen Ji's words fell. She stared at this seemingly timid Servant Disciple before her, then suddenly smiled. That smile was cold and dangerous, yet carried an indiscernible sense of relief: 'You are actually more interesting than I imagined.' She raised her hand, fingertips凝聚出一团幽紫光芒，一本mysterious的典籍在其中若隐若现。她的眼神中闪烁着危险的光芒，嘴角勾起一抹meaningful的弧度。

Shortly after, her brow creased slightly: 'You wish for me to conceal the energy fluctuations of the Tianji Record three times within a three-month period. In exchange, you'll aid me in averting three life-threatening crises at pivotal moments?' 'Precisely,' Chen Ji confirmed, standing with hands clasped behind his back. Moonlight illuminated his lean yet upright silhouette. 'Lady Ye should recognize the significance of these three concealments. While the Holy Sect's tracking techniques are unparalleled, they still harbor detection blind spots. I can provide precisely that blind spot for you.' Regarding the three life-threatening crises, Chen Ji's gaze was profound and unfathomable. He subtly probed: 'Lady Ye, how many adversaries exist within the Holy Sect? You likely understand better than anyone. During the 'Heavenly Demon Sacrifice' three months hence, you will be among the sacrificial offerings, correct?' Ye Qing's fingers violently clenched, the jade slip fracturing into several delicate cracks. Her silence provided the most eloquent response.

dialogue.content:
"Since Miss Ye has doubts, I'll show you something truly remarkable."

Chen Ji closed his eyes, and within his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly burst forth with a faint golden radiance. After a moment, he opened his eyes, and there was a barely perceptible dimness within his pupils.

"In three breaths, Miss Ye, there will be a falling leaf on your right. It will land precisely on your shoulder."

The moment his words fell—

A withered leaf snapped from the night wind, drifting leisurely until it landed on her shoulder, perfectly accurate.

Ye Qing's pupils constricted sharply, a chill racing from her tailbone straight to her brain. She instinctively raised her hand, pinching that fallen leaf between her fingers, remaining silent for a long while.

"What... what kind of ability is this?"

Her voice trembled slightly, and in this moment, the Saint's pride and composure completely crumbled. She had seen countless secret arts, yet never encountered an ability so bizarre—not divination, not prophecy, but genuinely "seeing" events that had not yet occurred.

Chen Ji smiled faintly: "Does Miss Ye consider this sufficient sincerity?"

Ye Qing fell silent for a long while before finally speaking slowly: "What do you need?"

"I need Miss Ye's Demonic Path mist." Chen Ji stared directly into her eyes. "Your ability can conceal the aura of the Tianji Record, which means what that signifies, you should understand better than me."

"We cooperate, each taking what we need."

text.content:
Moonlight flowed like water, scattered between the two of them.

Ye Qing gazed at the fallen leaf in her hand, as if trying to peer through it to discern Chen Ji's true depths. After a long while, she tucked the leaf into her sleeve and raised her eyes to Chen Ji: "Very well. I agree."

Her voice was no longer cold, but carried a certain solemnity: "Three months, three concealments, three deadly tribulations. From tonight onward, I, Ye Qing, and Chen Ji are people on the same boat."

Chen Ji gave a slight nod: "There's one more matter."

"Speak."

"In seven days, I need Miss Ye to help me do one thing." His voice dropped a few degrees. "Meet a person for me."

Ye Qing's brow lifted slightly: "What kind of person?"

"Someone within the Tianqing Sect." Chen Ji's gaze was profound. "Someone... who shouldn't appear there in the first place."

A subtle tension pervaded the air.

Ye Qing did not pursue the matter further. She cast a deep glance at Chen Ji, then suddenly stepped forward, the distance between them narrowing abruptly.

The faint fragrance of "Midnight Orchid" on her grew increasingly intense, and at this proximity, Chen Ji could almost feel her breath.

"Chen Ji," her voice was gentle yet carried a dangerous allure, "Are you truly just a servant disciple?"

Beneath the moonlight, her phoenix eyes shimmered with complex brilliance—scrutiny, curiosity, and a trace of... anticipation that even she might not have noticed.

Chen Ji did not retreat, allowing her to approach, the corner of his mouth lifting in a meaningful arc: "What does Miss Ye think?"

The two gazed at each other, the air thick with ambiguous and dangerous energy.

At this moment, Ye Qing suddenly laughed lightly, stepping back three paces, resuming her icy, aloof demeanor: "Interesting. Since our cooperation is established, I'll take my leave first."

She turned to leave, yet suddenly paused.

dialogue.content:
"By the way, Chen Gongzi."

She did not look back, her voice drifting from the night wind, carrying a hint of an elusive smile: "Next time we meet, I'll introduce you to someone."

"Who?"

"Someone... you might find quite interesting."

As her words fell, the ghostly purple light blossomed once more, and Ye Qing's figure transformed into a streak of radiance, vanishing into the night sky. All that remained was a faint, lingering fragrance and those profound words, echoing in Chen Ji's ears.

Chen Ji stood at the cliff's edge, gazing toward where she had disappeared, a deep solemnity flickering in his eyes.

The person Ye Qing mentioned who "might be interesting"... who on earth could it be?

He glanced down at the yellowed Letter in his sleeve, brow creasing. The veiled implications Mo Xiansheng had written in the letter, coupled with Ye Qing's promise tonight, all seemed to point toward a mysterious Chess Game yet to be unveiled.

"Interesting," he murmured to himself, his smile deepening with implication. "It seems this game is far more complex than I imagined."

The night wind howled, dispersing his low words.

That night, at the Cliff Edge of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, two people who should never have crossed paths forged a pact capable of shaking the world.

The cost and reward of this agreement remained hidden within layers of mist, awaiting the day they would be revealed.

Her voice trembled slightly. At this moment, all the Holy Maiden's pride and composure crumbled completely. She had witnessed countless secret techniques, yet never before had she encountered an ability so bizarre—not divination, not augury, but genuinely "seeing" things that had not yet come to pass.

Chen Ji smiled faintly: "Does Lady Ye think this constitutes sufficient sincerity?"

Ye Qing was silent for a long while before finally speaking slowly: "What do you need?"

"I need Lady Ye's Demonic Path mist." Chen Ji stared directly into her eyes. "Your ability can mask the Tianji Record's aura—this means something, and you understand it better than I do."

"We cooperate, each taking what we need."

text.content:
Moonlight like water, spilling between the two of them.

Ye Qing stared at the fallen leaf in her hand, as if trying to see through Chen Ji's background. After a long moment, she tucked the leaf into her sleeve and looked up at Chen Ji: "Fine. I agree."

Her voice was no longer cold, but carried a certain solemn weight: "Three months, three concealments, three death crises. From tonight onward, I Ye Qing and Chen Ji are in the same boat."

Chen Ji slightly nodded: "There's one more matter."

"Speak."

"In seven days, I need Miss Ye to help me with something." His voice dropped lower: "Meet someone for me."

Ye Qing raised an eyebrow slightly: "Who?"

"A person inside the Tianqing Sect." Chen Ji's gaze was profound: "Someone... who shouldn't be there."

A subtle tension hung in the air.

Ye Qing didn't press further. She gave Chen Ji a deep look, then suddenly stepped forward, closing the distance between them abruptly.

The faint fragrance of 'Heart-Bewildering Orchid' on her grew stronger, and at this close range, Chen Ji could almost feel her breath.

"Chen Ji," her voice was soft yet carried a dangerous allure, "are you really just a servant disciple?"

Under the moonlight, her phoenix eyes gleamed with complex light—scrutiny, curiosity, and a trace of... anticipation that even she might not have noticed.

Chen Ji didn't retreat, allowing her to approach, the corners of his mouth curving into a meaningful arc: "What does Miss Ye think?"

The two locked eyes, the air thick with ambiguous and dangerous atmosphere.

Just then, Ye Qing suddenly laughed lightly, stepped back three paces, restoring her cold and distant demeanor: "Interesting. Since our cooperation is settled, I'll take my leave first."

She turned to leave, then suddenly paused.

dialogue.content:
"By the way, Young Master Chen."

She didn't look back, her voice drifting through the night wind with a faint, intangible smile: "Next time we meet, I'll take you to see someone."

"Who?"

"Someone... you might find quite interesting."

As her words fell, the ethereal purple light bloomed once more. Ye Qing's figure dissolved into a stream of light, vanishing into the night sky. All that remained was a faint lingering fragrance and that meaningful parting phrase, echoing in Chen Ji's ears.

Chen Ji stood at the cliff's edge, gazing toward where she had disappeared, a trace of solemnity flickering in his eyes.

Who was this person Ye Qing mentioned that he "might find interesting"...?

He glanced down at the yellowed letter in his sleeve, brow creasing. The cryptic implications Mo Xiansheng had written in his correspondence, along with Ye Qing's promise tonight, seemed to point toward some mysterious chess game yet to be unveiled.

"How interesting." He murmured to himself, the smile at the corner of his mouth deepening: "It appears this game is more intricate than I imagined."

The night wind howled, scattering his quiet words.

This night, at the cliff's edge on the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, two people who should never have crossed paths made a pact that could shake the world.

The cost and reward of this pact remained hidden within layers of mist, waiting for the day it would be revealed.

dialogue.content:
"Why be nervous, Miss Ye?"

Chen Ji smiled lightly, his expression carrying a worldly calm: "I'm merely a servant disciple—hardly qualified to investigate matters of the Holy Sect. Yet... some things require no investigation to perceive."

He pointed at his own eyes: "For instance, I observed that each time you mention the Holy Sect, your right hand unconsciously clenches. And furthermore..."

His voice dropped lower: "Three days before the Heavenly Demon Sacrifice, the Saintess must enter the 'Demon God Abyss' for seclusion alone. But on the night before your seclusion, Miss Ye, you stood before the Sect's 'Remembrance Stele' for an entire night."

Ye Qing's pupils constricted sharply.

That remembrance stele was where Holy Sect Saintesses inscribed their final words—their last opportunity to write their own epitaphs.

"Who exactly are you?"

Ye Qing's voice turned sharply pitched, demonic energy churning around her like an enraged beast whose reverse scale had been touched. Murderous intent blazed in her eyes, yet she forcibly suppressed it the next instant.

Because she suddenly realized—if Chen Ji were merely an ordinary servant disciple, he could never have known these things.

"Who sent you?" Her voice was cold as a blade: "The Tianqing Sect? Or... someone else entirely?"

Chen Ji shook his head: "Neither. I am merely... someone who has seen things that shouldn't be seen."

He paused, then suddenly shifted topics: "But tonight I haven't come to pursue Miss Ye's identity—I've come to offer you a choice."

"What choice?"

"A choice to survive."

text.content:
Under the moonlight, Chen Ji's figure appeared increasingly mysterious in Ye Qing's eyes.

She fell silent for a long while before finally speaking: "Speak."

Chen Ji extended the Jade Slip: "Three months. You conceal the Tianji Record's spiritual fluctuation for me three times. In exchange, I will resolve three death crises for you at critical moments."

"The Tianji Record?" Ye Qing accepted the Jade Slip, her spiritual sense probing within, brow furrowing: "What is that?"

"Something... very special." Chen Ji didn't elaborate: "Miss Ye only needs to know that its aura is easily traced. And your Holy Sect's 'Demon Mist Secret Technique' happens to be the best method to conceal such an aura."

Ye Qing contemplated for a moment, then suddenly laughed lightly: "Chen Ji, you've calculated well. I shield disasters for you, you solve difficulties for me. Seemingly fair, yet in truth..."

She stepped closer, their eyes meeting: "You're clearly saving my life."

"Miss Ye may interpret it that way." Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged: "But consider this from another angle—you're also saving your own life. If I lacked sufficient value, why would I risk cooperating with the Holy Sect's Saintess?"

The two locked eyes, a silent contest弥漫在空气中。

"Finally, Ye Qing was the first to look away.

She lowered her head to gaze at the Jade Slip in her hand, her voice suddenly carrying a hint of exhaustion: 'Fine. I agree.'

She raised her hand, a wisp of ghostly purple light condensing at her fingertip: 'But I have one condition.'

'Speak.'

'Whatever you see, everything about me... don't tell anyone.' Her voice was soft, yet carried an unwavering resolve. 'This is my bottom line.'

Chen Ji nodded: 'Deal.'

The ghostly purple light flew from her fingertip, merging into Chen Ji's brow center. It was a strand of Demonic Path mark, allowing him to summon Ye Qing's assistance at a crucial moment.

At the same time, Chen Ji flicked out a Jade Talisman, which flew into Ye Qing's palm: 'This is my communication Jade Talisman. You can contact me through this if you need to.'

Ye Qing took the Jade Talisman, gazing at it for a moment, then suddenly smiled.

That smile was no longer the cold, distant expression from before, but carried a hint of genuine warmth: 'Chen Ji, I'm becoming more and more curious. Are you the type who hides their true strength, or are you really just a luckytrash?'

'What does Miss Ye think?' Chen Ji asked in return.

'I think...' she leaned close to his ear, her breath like orchids, 'you're the most interesting person I've ever met.'

With those words, she drifted away like a spirit, leaving only a lingering fragrance in the night wind.

But just as her figure was about to vanish, her voice came once more: 'By the way, in seven days, I'll take you to meet someone. Someone you would never expect.'

'Who?'

'You'll find out then.'

Ghostly purple light streaked across the night sky as Ye Qing's figure vanished completely into the moonlight.

Chen Ji stood rooted to the spot, gazing toward where she had disappeared. A deeper meaning flickered in his eyes.

Who was the person Ye Qing wanted him to meet?

The answer to this question might exceed his expectations.

But no matter what, tonight, this chess piece has been placed.

From now on, he and Ye Qing would be allies sharing the same boat.

And where this ship would sail...

To be continued."

dialogue.content:
"'Miss Ye,' Chen Ji's voice was calm yet confident, 'I have no intention of displaying any abilities to you. In your eyes, I may just be an不知天高地厚的 servant disciple. But there is one thing I can promise you.'

He looked directly into Ye Qing's eyes: 'At the Heavenly Demon Festival three months from now, you will not die.'

Ye Qing's movements froze.

In that instant, the coldness and scrutiny on her face completely collapsed, replaced by an indescribable shock.

Heavenly Demon Festival.

Those three words hung like a sword over her head for整整 three years. Every day, every night, she survived in the shadow of that blade, knowing its edge would fall eventually, yet powerless to resist.

And yet this servant disciple she had regarded as an ant actually spoke those words so casually.

'What makes you say that?' Her voice trembled slightly, yet she forced herself to maintain that mask of indifference."

"'Because I know certain things.' Chen Ji said calmly, 'For instance, you are not the only sacrifice at the Heavenly Demon Festival. For instance, someone within the Holy Sect does not wish you to die in that ceremony. And for instance...' 

He paused slightly: 'For instance, your义父—the Vice Sect Master of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path—has actually been secretly searching for your replacement.'

Ye Qing's expression completely changed.

Her lips trembled slightly, her eyes flickering with complex light—there was anger, there was unwillingness, and also a faint, almost unbelievable hope.

'You...' she took a deep breath, forcing herself tocalm下来, 'what do you want?'

'I told you.' Chen Ji handed her the Jade Slip, 'Three months, three concealments, three deadly crises. Fair trade, each taking what they need.'

'That's it?'

'That's it.' Chen Ji's gaze was profound, 'But I can give you an additional promise—if I can truly save your life on the day of the Heavenly Demon Festival, I want you to答应我一件事.'

'What thing?'

'I can't say now.' Chen Ji shook his head, 'But I can assure you, it will never为难 you.'

Ye Qing fell silent.

Under the moonlight, her face was half-hidden in shadow, her expression unreadable. After a long while, she finally extended her hand and took the Jade Slip.

'Fine. I答应 you.' Her voice was soft, yet carried a certain determination, 'But if you骗 me...' 

'Don't worry, Miss Ye.' Chen Ji smiled faintly, 'I never骗人. It's just that some things, now is still not the time to say them.'"

text.content: A幽紫色的光芒从夜清掌心涌出，融入那枚玉简之中。片刻之后，玉简上浮现出一道玄奥的符文——那是魔道圣宗的契约印记。「这是圣宗的『心魔契』。」夜清的声音恢复了calm，「一旦签订，双方不可反悔，否则必遭心魔反噬。你……敢签吗？」陈机没有hesitated，直接将玉简按在额头上。一缕神识探入其中，与那道符文产生共鸣。嗡——一道无形的力量从玉简中涌出，缠绕在两人之间。那是因果的丝线，是命运的契约。契约生效的瞬间，陈机感觉到自己与夜清之间建立了一种微妙的联系。他能隐约感知到她的情绪fluctuation，而她……或许也能感知到一些他的东西。「有意思。」夜清轻声呢喃，看着手中那枚已经恢复calm的玉简，「这契约比我想象中更加……深入。」她抬眸看向陈机，眼中闪过一丝complex的光芒：「从今往后，你我便是一条船上的人了。」「正是。」陈机slightly颔首，「希望我们合作愉快。」夜清没有说话，只是静静地看着他。月光洒在她脸上，那张冷艳的面容上竟浮现出一丝罕见的柔和。「陈机，」她忽然开口，「你真的只是一个杂役弟子吗？」「夜姑娘觉得呢？」「我觉得……」她轻声笑了，笑容中带着几分自嘲，「我觉得我可能遇到了一個比圣宗主还要可怕的家伙。」话音落下，她已转身离去。但在消失之前，她的声音再次传来：「七日后，我会带你去见一个人。一个……或许会让你很意外的人。」「是谁？」「到时候你就知道了。」幽紫色的光芒划过夜空，夜清的身影彻底消失在月色之中。陈机立于悬崖边缘，望着她消失的方向，眸中闪过一丝grave。夜清要带他去见的那个人……他的心中隐隐有了一个猜测，却不敢确定。无论如何，这盘棋，已经开始了。而他，必须走好接下来的每一步。
